subject: Interim P1/P2 response guarantee adjustment and escalation playbook (holiday coverage)
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@fastmerchant.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben.jacobs@fastmerchant.com, procurement@fastmerchant.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary response guarantee change for holiday weekend

Hi Laura,

Hope you're well — FastMerchant has a large holiday promotion planned for Nov 24-28 and we expect a 3–4x transient spike in inference traffic (checkout flows + fraud checks). Our legal and ops teams are pushing for very tight response commitments over that period.

We'd like to discuss a time-limited adjustment to the P1/P2 response guarantees for that window to allow tie-ins with your dedicated pool bursting plan. Specifically:
- Keep P1 target at 15 minutes but allow 30% of P1s to hit a 30-minute window (with credits if exceeded).
- For P2, allow a temporary extension from 4 hours to 6 hours for lower-priority flows.

Can Redwood publish an interim escalation playbook (contacts, on-call changes, war room trigger thresholds) we can rely on? Procurement asked for something signed by Oct 7 so they can correlate with our internal readiness checklist.

Thanks — can you loop in whoever owns on-call and escalation?

Best,
Anika Rao
Head of Site Reliability
FastMerchant

Attachments: none

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary response guarantee change for holiday weekend

Team — forwarding FastMerchant's ask (see below). They want an interim SLA amendment + escalation playbook signed by Oct 7. Quick summary of asks:
- 5-day time-limited SLA modification for Nov 24–28 (P1 partial allowance + P2 extension)
- Formal escalation ladder, war room trigger thresholds, and on-call contact list for that holiday window
- Procurement needs a PDF they can store with their runbook

Proposal from my side: we can offer a scoped, time-boxed 'Interim Response Guarantee' for that window with clear compensatory credit metrics and a predefined escalation flow. To protect Redwood and keep ops sane, we should:
1) Limit the modification to only a subset of FastMerchant endpoints (checkout and post-checkout fraud) — avoid catalog/low-priority flows mixing in.
2) Require proactive caching and KV warm-up steps agreed by Oct 12 so our capacity plan is accurate.
3) Publish an escalation playbook that includes SRE on-call, Redwood platform ops, and a named FastMerchant ops lead.

Grace/Rishi/Marcus — can you each confirm feasibility? Rishi, can you propose the war room thresholds (error rate, 95th latency delta, retries/sec) and the on-call adjustments required? Marcus, can infra commit to burst capacity + canary monitors for that window?

I attached a draft on-call roster and a flowchart I assembled for similar events. We should keep the external-facing PDF short and prescriptive (1 page + contact appendix).

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: holiday_oncall_roster.xlsx, escalation_flowchart.png

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary response guarantee change for holiday weekend

Laura / team — reviewed FastMerchant's ask. High level: I think we can accommodate a scoped, time-boxed relaxation with firm compensatory credits and a runbook containing clear triggers and contacts. Key items I need to confirm:
- Exact endpoint list from FastMerchant (we should get a path list / route regex). No blanket "checkout" — be explicit.
- War room triggers I propose:
  * sustained P1 rate > 0.5% of requests for > 10 minutes
  * 95th latency increase > 200ms relative to baseline for 15 minutes
  * error rate > 0.25% for > 5 minutes
When any of these triggers fire, auto-page SRE on-call (pager), then platform-ops, then manager (Sean).

On-call adjustments:
- We'll need a temporary on-call shadow for the overnight Pacific window (Nov 24–27). I'll coordinate a 48-hour rotational backfill split across two SREs to avoid fatigue.
- Marcus please confirm burst capacity knobs (reserve GPUs, pre-warm KV caches).

I'll draft the escalation playbook doc and a one-page interim SLA with credit calculation (credit = 2% of monthly invoice per 30-minute P1 block over allowance, capped at 20%). That should give procurement something tangible.

Rishi
VP, Support & Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Anika Rao <anika@fastmerchant.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@fastmerchant.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com, procurement@fastmerchant.com
Date: 2026-10-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Interim response guarantee + escalation playbook — proposal attached

Anika / Ben — thanks for the details and timeline. Please find attached Redwood's proposed Interim Response Guarantee (PDF) and the escalation playbook for Nov 24–28. Highlights:
- Scope: applies only to the route prefixes you confirmed (checkout/v1/charge, checkout/v1/confirm, fraud/post-check). Other routes are unaffected.
- P1 allowance: up to 30% of P1s can fall into the 30-minute response window during the timebox; any excess beyond allowance will trigger credits (2% of the monthly invoice per 30-minute block, capped at 20%).
- P2 extension: P2 target extended from 4h -> 6h for scoped endpoints only for the timebox.
- Escalation ladder: auto-page SRE on-call -> platform-ops (Marcus) -> account manager (Laura) -> executive on-call (Sean). War room thresholds included.
- Operational commitments: pre-warm KV caches, reserve 2x GPU burst capacity in SFO region, canary monitors enabled 72 hours prior.

Next steps I propose:
1) FastMerchant to sign the attached PDF interim amendment by Oct 7 (procurement request).
2) Rishi & Marcus to confirm on-call roster and pre-warm runbook (copy attached) by Oct 12.
3) Joint canary smoke test Oct 20–22 (30-minute windows) — we'll coordinate times.

If this looks good, Ben/Anika please reply with the list of exact routes to be covered and procurement can sign.

Thanks — Laura
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: interim_sla_amendment.pdf, holiday_oncall_roster.xlsx, escalation_flowchart.png
